result.title: Beyond Weight Updates: Evolving Agent Harnesses for Domain Specialization
result.summary: Domain specialization of LLM agents is usually framed as a weight-update problem: collect trajectories, run reinforcement learning (RL) or supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and deploy a new checkpoint. We study a complementary axis: evolving the \textbf{agent harness}---the system prompt, tool schemas, skill library, and planning scaffolding---while keeping the policy frozen. We cast harness evolution as an RL-style outer loop and instantiate it with GEPA, a reflective evolutionary optimizer. The resulting harness adapters require no GPU training, are loadable per vertical domain, and compose with weight-based RL. Experiments with Codev, a Claude Code-style coding agent, on SWE-bench Verified, OfficeBench, and Terminal-Bench show a consistent pattern: weight updates give the strongest single-path gains, harness evolution recovers most of those gains at a small fraction of the compute, and combining both paths is best overall. We also analyze a failure mode of SFT-based specialization---shortened reasoning chains and increased truncation---and argue that harness adapters avoid it by construction. Our results position harness evolution as a practical, non-destructive complement to weight updates for vertical agents.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把 LLM agent 的领域特化从权重更新扩展到「agent harness」（系统提示、工具 schema、技能库、规划脚手架）的演化，用 GEPA 反射式进化优化器在冻结策略下构造 RL 式外层循环，并在 SWE-bench Verified、OfficeBench、Terminal-Bench 上比较权重更新、harness 演化及二者组合的效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理主线无直接关联，但其「不动权重、在外层以文本反射搜索推理脚手架」的做法可能为 LVR 提供借鉴线索：可否用类似外层搜索来配置 latent 推理步数、视觉证据注入位置或停止决策结构，仍需核查其可迁移性。
